# Fable 5.5 release by end of Oct 16, 2026: research brief (information as of 2026-10-15)

**Bottom line:** As of Oct 15, nothing on Anthropic's newsroom marks a Fable 5.5 release. The evidence for a release soon is one Azure catalog listing on Oct 13 plus unverified social media posts. Prediction markets I found ask about a later deadline (Oct 31). I found nothing that pins a launch to Oct 15-16.

## 1. Resolution source
- The source is anthropic.com/news. I fetched it, and I count only items dated on or before Oct 15. There is no Fable 5.5 post. The latest model posts are:
  - Claude Haiku 5.5 (Oct 7)
  - Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Sep 28)
  - Claude Opus 5.5 (Sep 22)
  - "Claude Mythos and Fable 5.1" (dated Sep 15 on the newsroom)
  
  The newest non-model posts are Oct 15 (METR given evaluation access) and Oct 14 (election safeguards, Singapore office). [anthropic.com/news](https://www.anthropic.com/news)
- Date conflict: several third-party sites give Fable 5.1's release as Sep 1, 2026, but the newsroom post is dated Sep 15.

## 2. Current status
- As of Oct 15, nothing settles the question. There is no official Fable 5.5 announcement.
- 2026-10-14: Fake "Introducing Claude Fable 5.5" posts circulated. A tracker lists them as debunked (not from Anthropic). [emergent.sh](https://emergent.sh/news/claude-fable-5-5-release-date), [geotoolbox.ai](https://geotoolbox.ai/blog/claude-fable-5-5)
- A Medium post titled "Claude Fable 5.5 Is here" is not backed by any Anthropic page. [Medium](https://medium.com/data-science-in-your-pocket/claude-fable-5-5-is-here-f6961e621590)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-13: The model ID `claude-fable-5-5` reportedly appeared in Microsoft Azure's model catalog (East US 2), marked "Generally Available."
  - At 12:27 UTC, LiteLLM's price-sync bot added `azure_ai/claude-fable-5-5`.
  - Its price, context and deprecation fields matched Fable 5.1 exactly ($10 input / $50 output per million tokens), which suggests placeholder data. [36kr](https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/4027724934336903), [daily.dev](https://daily.dev/posts/claude-fable-5-5-shows-up-in-azure-configs-as-polymarket-expects-an-october-release-f1hffcfsf), [pasqualepillitteri.it](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/ja/news/23521/claude-fable-5-5-azure-katarogu-anthropic-chinmoku)
- An X account posted "Fable 5.5 is coming today, as per sources." I could not confirm the post's exact date, and it is unverified. [X/@vikktorrrre](https://x.com/vikktorrrre/status/2112496048723669433)
- October: The Information reportedly said Anthropic will ship a new model this month, without naming the model family. [kingy.ai](https://kingy.ai/blog/claude-fable-5-5/)
- 2026-10-02: An X post claimed Fable 5.5 beats "GPT-6 Astra." Nothing beyond that post and a quote of it is established. [orcarouter.ai](https://www.orcarouter.ai/it/blog/claude-fable-5-5-polymarket)
- Naming history:
  - The model was reportedly called "Fable 5.2" on Sep 5 and Sep 8, and "Fable 5.5" from Sep 10.
  - The 5.5 claim traces back to an Aug 13 X post about a pretraining run.
  - A leak claims it beats Opus 5.5. [orcarouter.ai](https://www.orcarouter.ai/blog/claude-fable-5-5-this-week-leak), [pasqualepillitteri.it](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/20012/claude-fable-5-5-leak-beats-opus-5-5)

## 4. Base rates
- Anthropic shipped about one model a week from mid-September to early October:
  - Fable 5.1 / Mythos: Sep 15
  - Opus 5.5: Sep 22 (7 days later)
  - Sonnet 5.5: Sep 28 (6 days later)
  - Haiku 5.5: Oct 7 (9 days later)
  
  By Oct 15 it had been 8 days since Haiku 5.5. [anthropic.com/news](https://www.anthropic.com/news)
- Fable 5.1 to a possible Fable 5.5 would be a gap of only about 1 to 1.5 months.
- In the past, models have appeared in cloud catalogs before launch, often days ahead. That has not always meant a launch within 1-3 days. I found no systematic data on the lag between an Azure listing and Anthropic's announcement.
- A 2-day window (Oct 15-16) is narrow. I found no source naming either date.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-10-07 snapshot of Polymarket's "Next Fable Model (5.2+) released by...?":
  - Oct 31: 91¢
  - Dec 31: 97¢
  - Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 are excluded, and any Fable model numbered 5.2 or higher counts. [orcarouter.ai](https://www.orcarouter.ai/sv/blog/claude-fable-5-5-polymarket)
- Another report cited about 94% for release by Oct 31. [kingy.ai](https://kingy.ai/blog/claude-fable-5-5/)
- I could not find a Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold price for an Oct 16 deadline, and I could not find the Manifold market this question appears to come from.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- No Anthropic event or announced date for Oct 15-16 was found.
- Things to watch:
  - anthropic.com/news, for any post through 11:59 PM PST on Oct 16
  - Azure, Bedrock or Vertex catalog changes
  - Claude.ai or Claude Code model pickers
- Anthropic usually launches on weekdays, and Oct 16, 2026 is a Friday.

**Caveat:** Several pages I tried to open (testingcatalog, 36kr, daily.dev, cellcog) were blocked by the proxy, so some details above come from search-result summaries. I left out every item dated after Oct 15.
